title: American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS)
summary: Visit 3D Systems at AAOS 2027 to explore personalized surgical solutions, VSP® planning, implants, and additive manufacturing innovations for orthopedics.
body_markdown:
3D Systems is Transforming Orthopaedics Patient Care


From concept and design to regulatory clearance and device manufacturing, you can count on 3D Systems’ solutions to transform patient care for a better future. Leverage our comprehensive approach to additive manufacturing to devise high-quality implants, instruments and models. As a pioneer in personalized healthcare solutions, our team has collaborated with medical professionals on 400k+ patient-specific cases and devices delivered and additively manufacture more than 3 million implants and instruments for 100+ CE-marked and FDA-cleared devices.


Visit us in booth #2923 to see these solutions for:
• Hip
• Knee
• Ankle
• Shoulder
• Spine


Stop by our booth, #2923:
March 3: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
March 4: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
March 5: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM
